# Browser dependencies

These files are served locally by the finance add-on so rendering does not depend
on the user's browser being able to reach public CDNs.

- `vue.global.prod.js`: Vue 3.5.44, MIT, https://unpkg.com/vue@3.5.44/dist/vue.global.prod.js
- `tailwindcss.browser.js`: Tailwind CSS browser build 3.4.17, MIT, https://cdn.tailwindcss.com/3.4.17
- `d3.min.js`: D3 7.9.0, ISC, https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3@7.9.0/dist/d3.min.js
- `d3-sankey.min.js`: d3-sankey 0.12.3, ISC, https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3-sankey@0.12.3/dist/d3-sankey.min.js
